decisions.reason: As a multi-model lever handle family close to the established offer, it has accumulated substantial design and tooling investment and remains part of the core range, so management is inclined to persist.

This single door handle design involves less visible commitment and fewer sunk resources than the product families, but its accumulated investment and fit with the core range still make dropping unlikely.

The firm has publicly positioned this electronic access system as a flagship and central to its announced digital direction, with substantial investment and visible commitment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping very unlikely.
